slots.dense-layered-architecture/title: A governed integration layer can connect the journey without forcing consolidation
slots.dense-layered-architecture/experience-wh: Experience layer covers the requester portal, agent workspace, and supervisor decisions.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/services-why/: Orchestration layer covers case state and rules, exception routing, and integration events.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/foundation-wh: Platform layer covers identity and access, case data and audit, telemetry, and support.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/architecture-: These are proposed responsibilities, not a prescribed vendor product stack. Existing systems remain transaction owners; the diagram does not imply consolidation. Interface feasibility, data authority, retention rules, and control design require client review.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/governance-ba: The governance band defines product ownership, data stewardship, and change gates.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/security-band: The security band spans identity, least privilege, data retention, and monitoring.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/experience/in: Validate intake and show missing information while retaining alternate routes during transition.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/experience/wo: Make case state, assigned queue, evidence and next action visible to the people doing the work.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/experience/co: Review waiting decisions, escalation reasons and reassignment choices with accountable owners.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/services/orch: Distinguish missing information, waiting decisions, technical failure and genuine new demand.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/services/rule: Avoid an additional ungoverned copy of case state.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/services/inte: A canonical identifier and published event contracts connect the journey without requiring one platform in the first release.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/foundation/in: Keep transaction ownership in existing processing systems until an explicit migration decision.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/foundation/en: Apply identity, least privilege and retention controls across the case journey and its evidence.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/foundation/op: Observe processing and recovery events; connect service evidence to accountable operations owners.
slots.slide/takeaway: Layered responsibilities connect the journey while transaction ownership stays in existing systems.
